name: How long does the stucco texturing process take?

mainEntity.name: How long does the stucco texturing process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of the stucco texturing process depends on the size of the area, the chosen texture, and weather conditions. Typically, for an average-sized home, the application itself can take anywhere from a few days to a week once the base coats are dry. This timeframe includes preparation, application of the finish coat, and adequate drying time. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption while ensuring a high-quality, durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco texturing usually takes a few days to a week for an average home, depending on area size, texture, and weather, after base coats are dry.
